stages.name: Story + side content as you go
steps: Complete all five story chapters (12 story trophies).
In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house: the one missable step in the game.
Start stranger strands as they appear (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret).
Scan vehicles and study animals through the binoculars as you travel.
Try activities and collectibles you pass; they already count toward stage 2.
stages.summary: Play through the five story chapters and pick up side content as it appears. Progress toward the 100% checklist counts from the start, even though the checklist itself only becomes visible after the story.

stages.name: 100% checklist + challenges
steps: Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist category by category.
Finish all robberies first (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults).
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges and win all 14 drone races.
Complete 70 of 80 challenges, skipping the hardest 10.
Collect 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries.
Finish the collectible and activity trophies in this stage (22 trophies).
stages.summary: After the story, the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, Stats. It is lenient: closer to 60% true completion. You need 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied and 15 of 18 card sets, while robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be done in full.

stages.name: Strangers & Freaks + cleanup
steps: Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone if any are left.
Finish the 8th stranger strand for Strangers & Freaks.
Clean up the miscellaneous trophies (13 trophies).
Check the tracker for anything left, then collect the platinum.
stages.summary: Finish any stranger strands left open and clean up the miscellaneous trophies. Every quest giver tied to a trophy returns after the story, so nothing here is missable. The platinum pops with the last trophy.

warnings.text: Positive Mental Attitude is the only potentially missable trophy: the first meditation, with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1 after Down to Earth. Save manually before leaving Chapter 1.
warnings.title: The one missable step

warnings.text: There is no mission replay and no New Game+. Free-roam continues after the story, but a missed story moment cannot be replayed, so save at the start and end of every chapter.
warnings.title: No mission replay

warnings.text: Using a cheat disables trophies and saving on that save. Keep cheats off your trophy run entirely.
warnings.title: Cheats disable trophies

warnings.text: Some questlines are Lucia-only (Andy) or Jason-only (Tyrone, Bret). Switch characters to keep every strand moving.
warnings.title: Character-locked quests

warnings.text: The Irredeemable criminal profile cannot be undone. Steer clear of it on a trophy run, and beware quests with an hourglass: they expire, though they do not count for trophies.
warnings.title: The Irredeemable profile
